docs.title: Welcome to my recipe repo
docs.text: For now, there is only 1 recipe here, by special request. But hopefully soon there will be more as I get a chance to add them. You are free to copy these recipes. They are a mix of recipes I have collected from my mother's old recipe books, my experiments and changes I have made to various recipes I have found from a variety of sources.

docs.title: Focaccia
docs.text: This recipe can be warm or cold fermented depending on time constraints. The quantities suit a baking dish of about a X b cm.

docs.title: Ingredients
docs.text:
• 500g bread flour I use Laucke Wallaby flour as it has the highest protein level of any of the flour varieties available from the supermarket.

  • 375g water Focaccia likes to have a high hydration dough. I started with 80% hydration but the protein content of this flour isn't high enough so I dropped the hydration back a bit.
